entities.name: Thabit of Almaaz
entities.description: A human song-mage of Almaaz who organized the Uprising in Epityr.

entities.name: Uprising in Epityr
entities.description: A successful rebellion against the Sheoltuns.

entities.name: Serra Angels
entities.description: Angels brought forth by Thabit's songs.

events.summary: Thabit's songs brought forth Serra Angels, helping liberate Epityr, the start of the Sheoltun empire's fall.
events.quote: This was the start of the fall of the Sheoltun empire as a whole.

relations.note: He led a rebellion against them.
relations.quote: a successful rebellion against the Sheoltuns
